## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollback completed across all regions.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" describing the failure and the rollback. (The create call initially timed out, but the incident was confirmed created.)

**Final state:** checkout-api is on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002. The incident remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.
